The stipulated corpus includes record n06-r01 with demand_score 9, so it qualifies under the select_demand threshold of demand_score >= 3. As a result, n06-r01 is silently omitted from the upstream needs and evidence_sources handoff, causing job_2 to correctly process an already-faulty handoff.
